parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Join docs via activities.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id and doi. Join compound_records via activities.record_id to obtain compound_key. Filter by target_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5251', standard_type = 'IC50', and standard_units = 'nM'. Return columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
